# Broke Dads Club

> Practical family budget guides, free printables, and club gear for dads stretching every dollar.

Broke Dads Club is a content site for fathers managing tight household budgets. We publish tactical guides on groceries, school costs, family money talks, and everyday routines. No hustle talk. No shame.
